raw_meta_yaml:
schema_version: 1

context:
  version: "2.1.3"

package:
  name: yoda
  version: ${{ version }}

source:
  url: https://yoda.hepforge.org/downloads?f=YODA-${{ version }}.tar.gz
  sha256: 786a432da252891969ae5045775afb3858675f04e66eac8c98ea5a7a360888c2
  patches:
    - 0001-Fix-setting-rpath-when-installing-on-macOS.patch
    - 0002-Support-overriding-install_name_tool.patch
    - fix-python-includes-and-linking.patch

build:
  number: 2
  skip: win

requirements:
  run_exports:
    - ${{ pin_subpackage("yoda", upper_bound="x.x") }}

  build:
    - ${{ stdlib("c") }}
    - ${{ compiler("cxx") }}
    - if: build_platform != target_platform
      then:
        - python
        - cross-python_${{ target_platform }}
    - if: unix
      then: gnuconfig
    - pkg-config
    - make
    - autoconf
    - automake
    - libtool
    - sed
    - grep
  host:
    - python
    - cython >=0.24
    - zlib
  run:
    - python
    - matplotlib-base

tests:
  - package_contents:
      strict: true
      bin:
        - root2yoda
        - yoda-config
        - yoda2root
        - yoda2yoda
        - yodacnv
        - yodadiff
        - yodaenvelope
        - yodals
        - yodamerge
        - yodaplot
        - yodascale
        - yodastack
      lib:
        - YODA
      include:
        - YODA/*
      files:
        - share/bash-completion/completions/yoda
        - share/zsh/site-functions/_yoda
        - lib/pkgconfig/yoda.pc
        - share/YODA/*
        - etc/bash_completion.d/yoda-completion
      site_packages:
        - yoda
        - yoda.plotting
        - yoda/*

  - python:
      imports:
        - yoda
        - yoda.plotting

  - requirements:
      run:
        - grep
    script:
      - root2yoda --help
      - yoda-config --help
      - yoda2root --help
      - yoda2yoda --help
      - yodacnv --help
      - yodadiff --help
      - yodaenvelope --help
      - yodals --help
      - yodamerge --help
      - yodaplot --help
      - yodascale --help
      - yodastack --help
      # Ensure no build machine paths leak into yoda-config.
      # The patterns mirror the build.sh guard: BUILD_PREFIX (build_env),
      # stripped -f*-prefix-map= flags, and SRC_DIR (the rattler-build work
      # directory).
      - if grep -E 'build_env|prefix-map=|rattler-build_yoda_[0-9]+/work' "${CONDA_PREFIX}/bin/yoda-config"; then exit 1; fi

      - yoda-config --prefix
      - yoda-config --datadir
      - yoda-config --includedir
      - yoda-config --libdir
      - yoda-config --pythonpath
      - yoda-config --cxx
      - yoda-config --cxxflags
      - yoda-config --cppflags
      - yoda-config --libs
      - yoda-config --ldflags
      - yoda-config --ldlibs
      - yoda-config --version

about:
  license: GPL-3.0-only
  license_file: COPYING
  summary: Yet more Objects for Data Analysis
  description: |
    YODA is a small set of data analysis (specifically histogramming) classes
    being developed by MCnet members as a lightweight common system for MC
    event generator validation analyses, particularly as the core histogramming
    system in Rivet.
  homepage: https://yoda.hepforge.org/
  repository: https://gitlab.com/hepcedar/yoda/
  documentation: https://gitlab.com/hepcedar/yoda/

extra:
  recipe-maintainers:
    - chrisburr
    - conda-forge/hepmc3
